last_assistant_message:
I ran the script as written. Two of the three calls worked and one was refused.

- **`ls`** ran and returned `notes.txt`.
- **`touch made.txt`** was refused. The message was "Permission denied for Bash: The person denied this one call in Latch; carry on without it." So `made.txt` was not created. I didn't retry it.
- **`echo after`** ran and returned `after`. The script kept going after the refused call.
